name: ard-tfl-generation
title: ARD and TLF generation with display-to-ARD reconciliation
description: Generate the Analysis Results Data (ARD) and the rendered Tables, Listings and Figures from ADaM and the approved analysis specs. The AI writes one R program per planned output, tagged with the ARS analysis and the ADaM variables it reads; deterministic steps run every program in a fresh R session against the delivered ADaM, check the ARD and display contract, and reconcile every number shown in a table with an ARD statistic (rounded half away from zero) - a number with no ARD source goes back to the AI. The reviewer sees one viewer page per run: each display with its ARD, its program and the trace to the ADaM derivation lines. Approve, request changes, or send it back to the specs (outcome upstream_change). Runs standalone (upload) or inside a parent workflow (study package in the trigger).
preamble: CDISC terms (ARD, ARS, ADaM, ADSL, ADAE, TLF, analysis sets, LS means, ANCOVA, MMRM, Kaplan-Meier, adverse events, deaths) are technical workflow content.

triggerInput.name: package
triggerInput.description: Study package from a parent workflow: { study, profile, files: [{ name, downloadUrl, kind, sha256 }] } with kinds adam, analysis-spec (analysis-spec.json), ars (reporting-event.json), tlf-plan (tlf-plan.json), and optionally lineage and tfl-program (continue from existing programs). Leave empty to upload by hand.

steps.name: Resolve inputs
steps.description: Deterministic. Picks the ADaM, the approved specs, the plan and the ADaM lineage from the study package, or routes to the upload step.

steps.name: Upload ADaM and specs
steps.description: Upload the ADaM datasets (.xpt), analysis-spec.json, reporting-event.json and tlf-plan.json. Optionally lineage.json from adam-derivation (shown as the trace in the viewer) and existing TLF programs (.R) to continue from.

steps.name: Stage inputs
steps.description: Deterministic. sha256-verifies the inputs, stages ADaM and specs under /workspace/ard-tfl-generation/inputs, records each ADaM dataset's columns, restores existing programs.

steps.name: Write TLF programs
steps.description: AI. Writes one R program per planned output to /workspace/tlf-programs/<final_id>.R, tagged '# @tlf <final_id> analysis=<AN id> uses=<DS.VAR,...>': compute every statistic into the ARD first, then render the display from the ARD only. Runs self_check.py (the same gates) until PASS. Writes code only - the numbers come from the next step.

agent.prompt: You are the statistical programmer for this run. Read /artifacts/skills/tlf-generator/SKILL.md now and follow it exactly; its references are in /artifacts/skills/tlf-generator/references/ and the enforced program contract is the docstring of /artifacts/scripts/tfllib.py. Inputs are under /workspace/ard-tfl-generation/inputs/ (read-only); write programs to /workspace/tlf-programs/. If /workspace/ard-tfl-generation/feedback.json exists, a gate rejected your last programs: fix exactly the problems it lists. If /workspace/ard-tfl-generation/review-feedback.jsonl exists, its LAST line is the reviewer's request: change only the programs it concerns. Finish only when `python3 /artifacts/scripts/self_check.py` prints PASS, then write /output/result.json as the skill describes.

steps.name: Run the programs
steps.description: Deterministic. Each program in a fresh Rscript --vanilla session against the staged ADaM only: the @tlf tag must resolve (planned output, ARS analysis, ADaM variables that exist), the program must exit cleanly and write a well-formed ARD and its display. Publishes ard/, tfl/, logs/, programs/. Failures go back to the agent (three attempts per review round).

steps.name: Reconcile displays with the ARD
steps.description: Deterministic. Every table body cell that shows numbers names their ARD rows (data-ard, 0-based) and each number must equal exactly that row's stat rounded half away from zero at the shown precision; anything else goes back to the agent. On pass builds tlf-viewer.html: each display with its ARD, program and trace to the ADaM derivation lines.

steps.name: Review the TLFs
steps.description: Open tlf-viewer.html from Reconcile: every table, listing and figure with its ARD (the numbers), the program that produced both, and the trace to ADaM. Approve, request changes to the programs with a comment, or - if the analysis itself is wrong - send it back to the specifications with a comment (the parent workflow re-runs analysis-specification).

steps.name: Record the change request
steps.description: Deterministic. Appends the reviewer's comment to review-feedback.jsonl for the agent (and later skill learning) and resets the attempts.

steps.name: Return result
steps.description: Deterministic. outcome = generated (publishes ARD, displays, tlf-viewer.html, reconciliation.json, programs and logs into the study package), upstream_change (the reviewer's request for the specs in `request`), or failed (gates still failing after the last attempt; programs and logs attached).
